items.t: Automatic transmission slips, jerks or fails
items.note: Owners report $2,300–3,500 on average. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Timing chain rattle or whine from worn guides
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Total cost is usually $1,200–2,800. Owners of 2004 vans report about $3,300.

items.t: Power sliding door stops working or will not close
items.job: Replace the sliding door lock actuator (motor or cable repair may be needed instead)
items.note: RepairPal: $755–$793 total for a sliding door lock actuator. RepairPal used as the basis; the fix depends on whether the actuator, motor or cable has failed.

items.t: Front subframe rusts through
items.note: Owners report about $1,700 on average.

items.t: Front wheel bearings hum or growl
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly (one side)
items.note: RepairPal: about $164–$344 total for a front hub assembly (2009). RepairPal used as the basis; no parts catalog checked.

items.t: Front control arms, ball joints and tie rods wear early
items.job: Replace front lower control arms and align
items.note: RepairPal: $621–$739 for a control arm; YourMechanic: about $679–$807 shop price for a front lower ball joint (2008). Estimators used as the basis.

items.t: Alternator stops charging
items.note: RepairPal: $618–$1,203 total. RepairPal used as the basis; no parts catalog checked.

items.t: Cam or crank position sensor failure
items.job: Replace camshaft or crankshaft position sensor
items.note: YourMechanic: about $400–$800 for a camshaft position sensor (most years), up to about $1,260 at shops. YourMechanic used as the basis.

items.t: Worn engine mounts cause thumping
items.note: RepairPal: $1,181–$1,332 total. RepairPal used as the basis; replacing a single easy-to-reach mount can cost much less.

items.t: Oil leaks from valve cover and oil pan gaskets
items.note: RepairPal: valve cover gasket $283–$403 on 2011–2017 vans, up to $839–$1,015 when the rear cover under the intake is involved. Oil pan gasket is extra. RepairPal used as the basis.

items.t: Power steering hose wears through and leaks
items.note: RepairPal: $898–$1,002 total; YourMechanic: about $687–$925 shop price (2001 pressure hose). Estimators used as the basis.

items.t: Torn CV axle boots and clicking axles
items.note: YourMechanic: about $506–$795 per axle, up to about $1,290 at shops. YourMechanic used as the basis.

items.t: CVT jerks, hesitates or fails
items.note: Owners report about $4,500 on average.

items.t: Rear A/C leaks and stops cooling
items.job: Replace the rusted rear A/C line assemblies and recharge the system
items.note: Based on one 2016 owner's dealer bill of about $1,093 ($535 parts, $480 labor, plus refrigerant). CarComplaints: Quest A/C repairs average about $1,000. Aftermarket lines may cost less.
